# How to record the VitaHome demo

The app drives itself. You do not click anything while recording, you do not change pages, and you do not watch a clock. You read one large line at a time off a second screen. The whole thing runs 3:52.

### Three rules you cannot break

> 1. The video must be 4 minutes or shorter. Only the first 4 minutes are judged. This script runs 3:52.

> 2. Do not edit or cut the video afterwards. The judges score a live, unedited run. Record it in one go and upload it as it is.

> 3. On YouTube choose Public. Not Unlisted, not Private. A link that is not public can be counted as no entry at all.

### About the commands in this guide


**When you see a grey box, copy only the text inside the box. Do not type the word bash, and do not type anything else. The box holds one complete command, start to finish.**

To run one: press the Command key and the Space bar together, type the word Terminal, and press Enter. Click into the Terminal window, paste the line, and press Enter again.


## Part 1. Set this up once

About 15 minutes. You only ever do this once.

### 1.1  Put the appointment calendar on your phone

The calendar is already shared with tahsin@gravitilabs.com.

- On your phone, open the Gmail app and switch to the tahsin@gravitilabs.com account.
- Find the email from Google Calendar. Its subject contains VitaHome - appointments (demo).
- Tap Add this calendar. That is all.
If there is no such email, open this address on your phone while signed in as tahsin@gravitilabs.com, and tap Add:


```
https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0/r?cid=NzEyNDFkMDAxMjNkOGE1MDE2OTkzZWVkNmQzODIyMTViN2Q1NDc4ZDJjMTQ0YjExYjJkMWViN2ZiNDJmODZiZEBncm91cC5jYWxlbmRhci5nb29nbGUuY29t
```

If the calendar is added but stays empty: open the Google Calendar app, tap your profile picture at the top right, tap Settings, find VitaHome - appointments (demo) under tahsin@gravitilabs.com, and turn Sync on.

### 1.2  Check that the calendar works

- On the Mac, open Chrome at vitahome.vitamedas.com/console
- Click the button that says: seed patient. Wait for the small grey line under the buttons to say done.
- Click the button that says: book follow-ups. Wait about 15 seconds.
- On your phone open Google Calendar, pull down to refresh, and look about a week ahead at 1 in the afternoon. You should see exactly three entries, on three different days:
  - Cardiology follow-up, at Mercy General Heart Center
  - Primary care follow-up, at Mercy General Family Medicine
  - Cardiac rehab intake, at Mercy General Rehabilitation
Open one of them. It names the doctor, the discharge instruction it came from, and the medical record it is linked to. If you can see these three, the calendar is finished forever.

### 1.3  If the calendar ever fills up with old appointments

Every rehearsal books real appointments and they add up. Pressing the reset button before a take now deletes that patient's appointments too, so this normally takes care of itself. To wipe every appointment the system has ever created, run this command:


```
curl -s -X POST \
  "https://vitahome-gateway-205100594497.us-central1.run.app/demo/calendar/purge?includeUntagged=true"
```

It only touches the calendar the app created and shared with you. It cannot see or change anything else in your Google account.

### 1.4  You do not need a printed page

An earlier version of this guide asked you to hold a printed discharge summary up to the camera. That was wrong: you are making a screen recording, so there is no camera in the picture and nobody would see the paper.

The document is now shown on the screen instead, on the first page of the app. The audience reads it there, tries to find the dangerous line, and fails - which is the whole point of the opening. There is nothing for you to hold and nothing to print.

### 1.5  Get the screen recorder ready

- Press Command and Space together, type QuickTime Player, press Enter. If a file window opens, press the Escape key to close it.
- In the menu bar at the top, click File, then New Screen Recording.
- Click Options, and under Microphone choose MacBook Pro Microphone, or your headset if you are using one.
- Do not start recording yet. You just needed to know where this is.
Optional, and worth doing: show your phone inside the video. Connect the iPhone to the Mac with a cable. In QuickTime click File, then New Movie Recording. Next to the red button click the small arrow and choose your iPhone under Camera. Drag that window into the bottom right corner and make it small. Leave it there. On the phone, open Google Calendar.


## Part 2. Before every take

About 5 minutes, every time you record.

### 2.1  Check that everything is healthy

Run this command:


```
cd "/Users/bayraktar/Documents/New Apps/Hackhaton/vitahome" \
  && ./scripts/preflight.sh
```

It takes about a minute. The last line must say: clear to record. If any line is red, send that red line to Claude before you continue.

### 2.2  Open two windows

There are two windows. Window B tells you what to say and is never recorded. Window A is the app itself, and it is the only thing you record. You open Window B now; Window A appears by itself in step 2.3.

- Open a Chrome window at vitahome.vitamedas.com/director This is Window B. Put it on your second screen.
- If you have no second screen, you will put Window A on the left two thirds of the screen and Window B on the right third. QuickTime lets you select just Window A's area when you record.

**Window B has to stay visible while you record. If it is completely hidden behind another window, the browser slows it down. The app corrects for this, but a visible window is one less thing to go wrong.**

### 2.3  Prepare the demo on Window B

Press these buttons in order. After each one, wait for the small grey line underneath it to say done before pressing the next.

- 1 - reset
- 2 - seed
- 3 - seed 200 fleets   (this one takes about 20 seconds)
- 4 - open the stage window
A new window appears. That new window is Window A, the one you record. Move it to your main screen and make it large. Press Command and the plus key twice to zoom it in.

Underneath the buttons, Window B shows a Stage link box. Read it before you go any further. It tells you which window the app is about to drive.

- Says driving /capture - one window: you are ready. The GO button turns on.
- Says two or more windows answered: you have another copy of the app open. Either close it and press re-check, or click the one you are actually recording.
- Says no window answering: open vitahome.vitamedas.com/capture in a second window yourself, then press re-check. It will be found.

**Do not press GO yet.**

### 2.4  Silence everything

- On the Mac, click the clock at the top right and turn on Do Not Disturb.
- On the phone, turn on Do Not Disturb. The calendar still updates.
- Quit Slack, WhatsApp, Mail, and anything else that can pop up.
- Put the phone on the desk with Google Calendar open and the screen unlocked.

## Part 3. Recording

- In QuickTime click File, then New Screen Recording. Drag to select Window A's area. Click Record.
- On Window B press the button: 5 - GO
- Read the big line on Window B out loud. That is your whole job.
Window B shows one of three things above each line:

  - say - read the large text out loud at a normal pace. It moves on by itself when you finish.
  - silence - say nothing at all. The screen is doing the talking.
  - phone - then say - pull down to refresh the calendar on your phone, then read the line. The mirrored phone window is already inside the recording, so there is nothing to hold up.
Smaller grey text underneath a line is an instruction for you. Never read it out loud.

If you cough or lose your place, press the Space bar to pause, and press it again to carry on. If you finish a line early, press the right arrow key to move on.

- When the last line tells you to stop, stay silent for three seconds, then click the stop button in the menu bar at the top right of the screen.

**If something goes wrong while recording, say: and this is live, so let's watch it recover. Then keep going. The judges reward a live unedited run, so a visible recovery is worth more than starting again.**


## Part 4. Every word you say, in order

There are 29 steps and the whole run is 3:52. Window B shows you each one, so you do not have to memorise any of it. This list is here so you can practise.


*The screen moves by itself to the photograph page*

**1.** (0:00) Say:  
   **"A real discharge summary. Twelve instructions. One of them kills him if it is missed. Find it — ten seconds."**  
   *the document is on screen · say this over it*

**2.** (0:09) Say nothing for 6 seconds.  
    say NOTHING. the audience is failing to find it. that is the point.

**3.** (0:15) Say:  
   **"It took me three readings. I was in another country when my family got this one."**  
   *flat voice · say it once · never mention it again*

**4.** (0:22) Say:  
   **"So we hand the page to the fleet. No typing, no forms."**  
   *the parse starts by itself*

**5.** (0:27) Say nothing for 4 seconds.  
    say nothing until the list stops appearing

**6.** (0:32) Say:  
   **"Three seconds."**  
   *READ THE REAL NUMBER. the screen shows two: say the end-to-end one, which is the one the counter was climbing to.*

**7.** (0:33) Say:  
   **"Top of the list, in red: do not stop ticagrelor. Stopping a blood thinner early after a stent is how people die feeling fine."**

**8.** (0:44) Say:  
   **"On the page it was line seven, same font as no lifting over ten pounds. Here it is first, because it is fatal. The line underneath, the fleet wrote itself."**


*The screen moves by itself to the clinician console*

**9.** (0:56) Say:  
   **"Now the part nobody builds — someone has to carry them out. Usually a daughter with a phone tree."**

**10.** (1:04) Say:  
   **"Watch the counters. And watch my phone."**

**11.** (1:08) Say nothing for 12 seconds.  
    silence · wait for the purple REFUSED card

**12.** (1:20) Say:  
   **"Then it stopped. It refused. It did not guess — it assembled both readings, each citing its source line, and put a human in front of the decision."**

**13.** (1:32) Pick up the phone, then say:  
   **"Those appointments are in my phone's calendar — written through the Calendar API, same idempotency keys as the record. Remember this phone."**  
   *refresh the calendar on the phone — the mirrored window is already in shot*

**14.** (1:41) Say:  
   **"Look at that counter: refused. Everyone here is optimising for how much their agents do alone. In medicine that is the wrong axis."**  
   *point at the refused tile — it may read 1 or 2, both are correct*


*The screen moves by itself to the family's day view*

**15.** (1:51) Say:  
   **"The Pharmacist built the day. Amlodipine is held, not dropped — don't take this one until you hear back. The refusal travelled. The Coach asked one question."**  
   *the question on screen is chosen live — you may read it out if it lands*


*The screen moves by itself to the chaos panel*

**16.** (2:02) Say:  
   **"That was the happy path. Let me break it. This kills a real worker process, no cleanup. The Scheduler runs on its own Cloud Run service."**

**17.** (2:13) Say nothing for 1 seconds.  
    no words

**18.** (2:14) Say nothing for 2 seconds.  
    no words


*The screen moves by itself to the clinician console*

**19.** (2:16) Say nothing for 16 seconds.  
    SILENCE. this is the money shot — do not fill it.

**20.** (2:32) Say:  
   **"The process is gone. Nothing caught it. The message was never acknowledged, so Pub/Sub redelivered it, Cloud Run gave a fresh container — new worker id — and the finished step says SKIP. One appointment. One calendar event. Not two."**


*The screen moves by itself to the Google Cloud page (the address bar changes)*

**21.** (2:48) Say:  
   **"And this is what it runs on. Cloud Run, the Healthcare API, Gemini — every row checked by calling it, just now."**  
   *the address bar shows the .run.app URL — that is the proof*


*The screen moves by itself to the clinician console*

**22.** (2:58) Say:  
   **"Monitoring has been armed since minute one, against the red flags on this page. Chest pain — it paged a clinician, five-minute clock. It did not treat or advise. No agent can close it."**

**23.** (3:12) Say:  
   **"Now the harder one. Same monitor, different reading — lightheaded on standing."**

**24.** (3:17) Say nothing for 4 seconds.  
    let it settle · the audit stream shows the decision

**25.** (3:21) Say:  
   **"Nothing. It decided a human was not needed — and wrote down why, the strongest argument against itself, and what would have changed its mind. Anything can panic. Restraint is expensive."**


*The screen moves by itself to the 200-fleet grid*

**26.** (3:34) Say:  
   **"Two hundred fleets. Every square is a real patient record. Synthetic patients. Real infrastructure."**

**27.** (3:40) Say:  
   **"The hospital saves your life. Then it hands you a piece of paper."**  
   *the closing line · no action needed*

**28.** (3:46) Say:  
   **"We take it from there."**

**29.** (3:49) Say nothing for 3 seconds.  
    do not say thank you


## Part 5. Upload and submit

### 5.1  Check the file first

The recording is saved in your Movies folder or on the Desktop. Open it and check all four of these:

  - It is shorter than 4 minutes. This script is 3:52. If yours is longer, you paused during the take - record it again rather than cutting anything out.
  - You can hear your voice clearly the whole way through.
  - There is a moment where the web address at the top of the browser ends in run.app. That is the proof the judges need that it runs on Google Cloud.
  - Window B, the one with your lines on it, is not visible anywhere in the video.
### 5.2  Put it on YouTube

- Go to studio.youtube.com, click Create, then Upload videos, and drag the file in.
- For the title, use this:

```
VitaHome - an agent fleet that executes hospital discharge instructions
```

- For the description, use this:

```
VitaHome is a fleet of seven agents that carries out the instructions on a hospital discharge summary - reconciling medications, booking follow-ups, building the dose schedule, and watching for the warning signs printed on the page. The agents can refuse: where an instruction can be read two ways, the fleet stops and puts a clinician in front of the decision instead of guessing.

Built on Google Cloud: Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Firestore, the Cloud Healthcare API (FHIR R4), the Google Calendar API, and Gemini.

Everything in this video is a live, unedited run against the deployed system. The patients are synthetic; the infrastructure is not.
```

- Where it asks about audience, choose: No, it's not made for kids.
- Click Next three times until you reach Visibility.
- Choose Public. Not Unlisted. Not Private.
- Click Publish, then copy the link.
### 5.3  Put the link into Devpost

- Open your submission page on Devpost.
- Paste the YouTube link into the video field.
- Check the Try it out link still says vitahome.vitamedas.com
- Click Save, then click Submit. Only you can press Submit - nobody else can do that step for you.
